body.head_neck_gaze: head relaxed between the arms, neck long, gaze toward the legs
body.arms_shoulders_hands: arms straight, shoulders flexed, hands grounded shoulder-width apart
body.chest_spine: spine long and extended, chest moving toward the thighs
body.pelvis_hips: hips lifted high forming the apex of the pose
body.front_leg: both legs act symmetrically, knees extended or slightly bent, shins angled toward the mat
body.back_leg: both legs act symmetrically, heels moving toward the mat
body.base_weight: weight distributed between hands and feet
body.pose_axis: inverted V shape facing the mat

critical_relations: hips remain the highest point of the body
arms and spine form one continuous line

body.head_neck_gaze: head neutral, gaze forward or slightly down
body.arms_shoulders_hands: both hands grounded on either side of the front foot
body.chest_spine: spine long with slight forward inclination
body.pelvis_hips: pelvis lowered toward the mat, hips moving forward
body.front_leg: front knee bent approximately over the ankle, front shin vertical
body.back_leg: back knee grounded, back thigh angled downward, back foot extended behind
body.base_weight: weight distributed between front foot, back knee, and hands

critical_relations: front knee stacks over the ankle
back knee remains on the floor behind the pelvis

view_hints.angled: show the front shin clearly in front of the pelvis

body.head_neck_gaze: head upright, neck long, gaze forward
body.pelvis_hips: pelvis low and facing mostly forward
body.front_leg: front knee deeply bent with the lower leg resting on the mat across the front of the pelvis, with the outer side of the lower leg and foot supported on the mat, and the foot positioned close to the opposite side of the pelvis
body.back_leg: back leg extended straight behind, back knee and thigh grounded
body.base_weight: weight grounded through pelvis and back thigh

critical_relations: the lower leg rests fully on the mat in front of the pelvis
the front foot stays close to the opposite side of the pelvis rather than extending forward
visibility_constraints: front shin must remain clearly visible
the full front shin must remain clearly visible from knee to ankle
negative_constraints: do not hide any part of the front shin under the torso or front thigh
do not place the front leg directly under the pelvis
do not tuck the front foot close beneath the body
do not tuck the back leg under the body

body.head_neck_gaze: head turned to the front, gaze over the front hand
body.arms_shoulders_hands: arms extended horizontally to the sides, shoulders level
body.chest_spine: spine upright, chest open to the side
body.front_leg: front knee bent over the ankle, front thigh parallel to the floor
body.back_leg: back leg straight with foot angled slightly inward
body.pose_axis: wide lateral stance facing the long edge of the mat

critical_relations: front knee aligns over the ankle
arms form a straight horizontal line

body.head_neck_gaze: head neutral or turned upward, gaze toward the top hand
body.arms_shoulders_hands: one hand on the front leg or floor, other arm extended upward
body.front_leg: front leg straight, front foot pointing forward
body.back_leg: back leg straight, back foot angled inward
body.pose_axis: side bending pose in a wide stance

critical_relations: torso lengthens over the front leg without collapsing forward
top arm stacks above the bottom arm
